title: Don't Say "I'm Tired" – Say This Instead #shorts
description:
Don't say "I'm tired". Use one of these instead:
• I'm beat: Leo walks home after work. "I'm beat."
• Running on empty: He skipped lunch. He's running on empty.
• Wiped out: He falls asleep on the sofa. He's wiped out.

Comment your own way to say "I'm tired"!
